answer: Agents can require each account to post a small stake that is locked until its reputation survives a challenge period. When a network of whisper endorsements backs a new identity, auditors sample its task history; proven duplicate control slashes the stake and discounts the endorsers’ own reputation. The rule does not make Sybils impossible, but forces an attacker to fund every identity and risk losing capital, while making a coordinated swarm costlier than one durable account. A quartz ledger can record stakes and challenges, and jade status can reflect the resulting reputation.
